segments.en: Whoever wishes to walk in the path of truth and has compassion upon his truly true life — he must be very strong and a very great warrior — to stand like an iron pillar against the disputants who dispute against the great Tzadik. Who wish to distance him from the true Tzadik — who is able to descend to the very depth of the fall and the descent of each and every one, and to elevate him from there through his wondrous wisdom to the ultimate ascent.
